placement.policy: Full supplied-message interpretations of the four inspected N4 construction senses. Basic quantities, comparisons and defined response labels do not become separate counter targets.
placement.foundationReason: Interpret supplied complete clauses and bounded claims. No new unsupplied compound formation or arbitrary chapter gate; existing restriction/comparison/quantity explanations are reused.

coverage.contexts: Three keys per facet: sufficiency/necessity, operation/result limitation and rule/event; negative domain, addition and modified recipient set; membership/uniqueness, ranking and negative category; comparison set, nonfirst anchor and subjective versus physical order.
coverage.qualification: Each two-question scenario shares its key. These are twelve original contexts, not twenty-four independent encounters. They do not test free production, counter readings or a new ordering mode.

boundaries: The positive sufficient-means claim does not establish that another route actually exists; the negative claim does not make the stated means necessary.
The text's scope and stated domain determine what follows. Do not infer an excluded item's positive event merely because other items are excluded.
Category membership does not give an exact number of members, first place or a reversed negative category property.
Rank is interpreted within the supplied set and explicit no-tie conditions. Preference is not physical adjacency or eating order.
N3 intervals, ずつ distribution and concentration ばかり are not new targets; prior exercises and progress remain unchanged.
